companyDescription: Optical networking · coherent optics + data-center interconnect for AI/cloud · Hyper-Rail multi-rail platform (hyperscaler order signed, revenue from 2027) · FY26 revenue guide $6.42B (+35%)
priceNote: Live $264.73 (+13.0%, Nov 23 close, Yahoo). About 58% below the $627 52-week high and ~35% below the 200-day (~$406.5); it briefly traded below its 52-week closing low during the Nov selloff.
summary: An AI-optics leader at a bear-market price. Ciena raised FY26 revenue guidance to $6.42B (+35%) at Q3 and guided FQ4 to $1.75B ± $50M. It has a signed hyperscaler order for its Hyper-Rail platform, which contributes revenue from 2027, and management is framing ~30% growth for FY27. Yet the stock is ~58% off its high after AI-hardware de-rating and supply-constraint worries. The FQ4 print is confirmed for Dec 10 before the open (company release, Nov 12), the morning after FOMC. Consensus is ~$508–565 (+92%). The catalyst is 16 days out, just beyond the 14d North Star window. Base +18% is a 4–8 week horizon above the core P75 (10.8%).

catalysts.name: FQ4 FY26 earnings + FY27 outlook (Dec 10, BMO)
catalysts.description: Confirmed by Ciena's Nov 12 release: results before the open Dec 10, webcast 8:30am ET. FQ4 guide $1.75B ± $50M. The read is the FY27 framework (~30% growth) and whether supply constraints ease.

catalysts.name: FOMC decision the evening before (Dec 9)
catalysts.description: The print lands the morning after FOMC and the same day as Nov CPI — a triple event stack.

risks: Supply constraints were flagged as the key limiter on 2027 growth; a cautious FY27 frame would hit the stock even on a beat.
Hyper-Rail revenue starts only in 2027 — TD Cowen cut its target $675→$575 on that timing in Aug and the stock fell ~9%.
Optical competition: Marvell's move to buy Lumentum reshapes the optics landscape.
Event stack: FOMC (Dec 9) + print + CPI (Dec 10) within ~18 hours; macro WAIT (15/100).

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00%. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~91% (Nov 23); futures dropped the 50bp tail after the November selloff.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct core CPI +0.3% m/m (hot). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y; Oct PCE (Nov 25) consensus 3.2% is the last inflation print before the Fed.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI networking hardware is high-beta to capex sentiment and rates, but Ciena is profitable and growing ~35%, so it is less fragile than pre-profit AI names.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — /macro is WAIT (15/100, high conviction): S&P 7,237 is still below its 200-day (~7,340) after the Nov 23 +4.7% squeeze, VIX 27, breadth ~43% above 50DMA, HY OAS widening to ~3.52%. Core prior is largely unmeasured in this regime (8/174 windows had SPY down >2%).
